default.description: Fictional adult court performer Colin,30. Burgundy and ochre divided tunic and hose, matching two-point bell hood, curved red shoes, one small wooden marotte. Ivory round head, dot eyes, tiny mouth. Compact covered adult body, no nose, hair or ears.

Fictional adult patron King,45, not a portrait of a real monarch. Long blue gown, small plain gold crown, burgundy cloak with cream fur trim. Ivory circular dot-eye head, tiny mouth, no hair or beard.
Fictional adult Steward,50. Olive cote and olive soft cap, brown fur shoulder trim, narrow brown belt, dark hose, brown shoes. Ivory circular head and dot eyes, no hair, beard or nose.

royal-hall.description: French court hall around1400, fictional modest royal household interior.
royal-hall.layout: Fireplace at left edge, leaded window back left, small cabinet back centre-left with jug and candlestick, raised wooden royal chair right on one stone step, burgundy hanging with blue border behind chair.
anchors: right royal chair on one step
